decision: Phase 7 acceptance is complete. The physical proof is bound to the fixed proof source SHA; later main only hardens the Windows return transport discovered during acceptance. Missing or budget-gated optional AI-provider participation must remain truthfully UNAVAILABLE and must never be simulated.
lessons: Windows PowerShell 5.1 UTF-8 BOM must be handled explicitly when Python validates JSON evidence.
Byte-addressed return manifests must normalize Windows/Git line endings before hashing and committing data-only evidence.
First-return cleanup must tolerate a return branch that does not yet exist.
Physical acceptance evidence is not complete until an independent verifier publishes a fixed-source artifact and owner-side temporary Courier material is removed.
